about: Usage caps per plan for AI coding tools. Every number is copied from the vendor page in 'sources' on its 'checked' date. Kinds: rel = multiple published by the vendor relative to another plan of the same tool; amt = published amount; np = a cap exists but its size is not published; none = no cap of this kind is published; nolimit = vendor says this window has no limit. 'v' is only used to scale the bars within one tool.

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.note: Pro and Max have a 5-hour session limit and a weekly limit, shared across Claude and Claude Code. Max also has a separate weekly limit for Fable. Anthropic says it may also apply weekly and monthly caps at its discretion.
tools.hit: Wait for the reset, turn on usage credits (billed at standard API rates), upgrade Pro → Max 5x → Max 20x, or switch to a Console API account.
guide: What happens when you hit Claude Code's weekly limit
sources: Claude help: Use Claude Code with your Pro or Max plan

tools.name: Cursor

tools.hit: Wait for the weekly refresh, buy top-ups (or Auto Top-up) at per-model rates, or upgrade for a bigger pool. Cursor says requests are never downgraded.
